text: On February 5, 2025, City Council adopted Official Plan Amendment 778 to revise policies related to Avenues and identify 283 kilometres of new Avenues. Official Plan Amendment 778 was appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal by five parties. Four case management conferences have been held. The Ontario Land Tribunal brought most of Official Plan Amendment 778 into force on July 24, 2025, with the exception of certain non-policy text and lands subject to site-specific appeals. Three of the appellants have withdrawn their appeals. A 5-day hearing is scheduled to commence on November 30, 2026. The City Solicitor requires further directions for the upcoming Ontario Land Tribunal hearing. This matter is urgent and cannot be deferred.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 15, 2026) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix A to the report (July 15, 2026) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 15, 2026) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
